name: Supercut
description:
Supercut is a screen recorder and video messaging tool for teams. This connector gives Claude access to your videos: transcripts, timeline comments, viewer analytics, and playlists. A recording becomes something to act on, not just something to watch.

Claude reads what was said and shown in a recording and uses it to summarize, answer questions, or draft what comes next: a doc, an SOP, a ticket, a follow-up message. Useful for catching up on a video without watching it end to end, pulling the feedback left on a demo, checking who watched something you shared, and turning a walkthrough into written documentation. Works alongside your other connectors: with Notion or Linear connected, Claude can take a transcript and draft the page or open the issue in the same conversation.

What Claude can do:

- Transcripts: pull the full transcript of any recording to summarize it, search it, or turn it into a doc or SOP.
- Recordings and playlists: list recordings across your workspace, look up a specific video, or see what's in a playlist.
- Comments and reactions: read the feedback and timeline reactions viewers left, including the timestamp each one sits on.
- Viewer analytics: see visit counts, unique visitors, and how a recording performed after you shared it.
- Form responses: read what viewers submitted on a recording.
- Frames: grab a still from a specific timestamp.
- Playlists: add a recording to an existing playlist.

Common uses: summarizing a recorded standup or meeting, turning a product walkthrough into an SOP, collecting demo feedback into a ticket, drafting release notes from a feature demo, and checking engagement on a video you sent to a customer.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Supercut to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Supercut to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.supercut.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Supercut MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Supercut provides these MCP tools: add-playlist-recording, get-frame, get-playlist, get-recording, get-transcript, list-comments, list-form-responses, list-playlist-recordings, list-playlists, list-reactions, list-recordings, and get-recording-analytics.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Supercut?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Supercut in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
Supercut requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Supercut is developed by Supercut. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
